text: most of the app works fine, but if I open the AI page the app crashes, and if im in the app too long it begins to stutter. Update: App works great now, no issues so far, thank you for resolving the issues, I will continue to use life engine.
author: Calder Springrose
developer_reply: Hi Calder, sorry about that, a crash is a horrible way to meet a feature. The AI section has been rebuilt from scratch in the latest update, so the page you were crashing on is not really the same page anymore. Could you update and tell me if it still happens, and whether the slowdown does too? Luc, Kafra Tech

text: Bro, not everyone is rich. Please consider regional pricing!
author: Chandru

text: Application is beautifully designed, I did the internal testing and till now it has been working great. the only issue i felt is that during the habit time it triggers the notification which is fine but at the same time it open the complete app as well even if user is doing something like using other app it is annoying a little bit as this app comes on the screen all of sudden, rest everything is fine.
author: Napender Singh
developer_reply: Hi Napender, thank you for testing, and for saying it so clearly. The app coming up over what you are doing is the part I most want to get right, and you are the first to raise it. Could you write to hello@kafra.tech so I can ask you two quick questions about when it happens? It would help a lot. Luc, Kafra Tech

text: the app is beautifully built, a unique design language ...the app had really helped me. the only small issue is: I think if the task is marked as completed, it shouldn't send a notification as if it's not done. but overally good job
author: Phoenix Griffin
developer_reply: Hi Phoenix, thank you so much, this really means a lot. And you spotted a real one: a habit you have already finished should never ping you again that day. That fix is now live, so it stops nagging you as soon as you update. Thank you for helping make it better. Luc, Kafra Tech

text: I have used so many habit trackers in my life, this is by far the best one out there. The app design, the template packs and information presented are all of those things combined makes this by far the best app out there without bloating too much information on my screen and keeping it simple which motivates me to do my stuff and also pick up new habits This app also keeps me moving, getting my things done. I really appreciate the developers behind this app. Thank you.
author: Aakash Kulkarni
developer_reply: Hi Aakash, this genuinely made my day, thank you. Simple but motivating is exactly what I set out to build, so hearing that it keeps you moving means everything. Thank you for trusting the app with your habits, and for taking the time to write this. I am just getting started. Luc, Kafra Tech

text: totally loving the app. question- Is there a way to mark habit complete for previous days? energy bar showed 75 but completing 5 habits filled energy bar to 77. that was a bit confusing.
author: Chinar
developer_reply: Hi Chinar, thank you, this genuinely made our day. Great timing: marking past days done is coming in an update very soon, straight from your suggestion. And you are right about the energy bar, we have reworked it so a finished day fills it exactly. Ideas are always welcome at hello@kafra.tech. The Kafra Tech Support Team

text: App keeps crashing just 10 seconds after launching, every time. Paid premium membership looking at the great design and ended up understanding that basics are not in place. Hope the developer fixes it soon.
author: Shankar V.K
developer_reply: Hi Shankar, we are so sorry, the app crashing like this is not okay, especially after you backed us with premium. A fix went out in the latest version, so if it is still happening we want to look into your case. Please write to us at hello@kafra.tech and we will get you sorted. The Kafra Tech Support Team

text: [PREV] The app is crashing immediately (within 10 seconds) upon opening, and my phone's status bar keeps blinking, making it completely unusable. Could you please look into this and release a fix as soon as possible? Thank you! [AFTER UPDATE] Still crashes after a few seconds as well as the status bar keeps blinking. Please Fix this ASAP
author: Tanishq Anand
developer_reply: Hi Tanishq, we are so sorry this is still happening after the update, that is not the experience we want for you. Something on your phone is still tripping it up and we want to fix it with you. Please write to us at hello@kafra.tech and we will get you sorted. The Kafra Tech Support Team

text: It's one thing to make a good User interface but it takes another level of dedication to get the User interaction right. This app nails both of them. I don't even need to use the app but I do anyway because it's that good!
author: Spandan Purohit
developer_reply: Thank you Spandan, this genuinely made our day, especially the note on the interaction. On the premium not going through, we would love to sort that out for you. Could you write to us directly at hello@kafra.tech so we can see what happened and get you set up? The Kafra Tech Support Team

text: Faced several issues: 1. Cannot undo accidentally completed tasks / Habit. 2. After deleting a task permanently, energy score doesn't adjust properly. 3. Also it still shows completed after deleting the task 4. Undo deleted tasks permanently.
author: muhammad hashim
developer_reply: Hi Muhammad, all four are fixed and live for a while now. Tap a habit again to undo it, and deleting one now clears its history, so your energy is right and it no longer shows as done. Bringing a deleted habit back is still on my list. If the new version works for you, I would be glad if you revisited your note. Kafra Tech

text: Cool app design. Google Sign in isn't working. The free week trial isn't working, and the pro features aren't showing up. Other than that, it's an awesome app.
author: Ali Mukashi
developer_reply: Thanks for the kind words! We identified and fixed the Google Sign-In and subscription activation issues in the latest update. Please update Life Engine to the newest version. If anything still isn't working, contact us at hello@kafra.tech and we'll help right away. Thanks for your patience and support!

text: you state free in Templates, but none are free. all pro
author: Dudes Pickle
developer_reply: You're right, and we've fixed it — that label was misleading. Template packs now show their true habit count with a PRO badge instead of claiming free items. Creating your own habits stays completely free (up to 5). The fix is already rolling out; restart the app twice to get it. Thanks for calling it out.

text: hy team it's a good app. but 3 bugs to address. 1. The app takes almost 2-3 min to start. just stuck on the logo.. 2. the habit group feature does not work. as I create a group but can't access it..! beside those, Good ui, font colours, actually great... hope you fix those problems soon.
author: JAYESH ANNA THAKARE
developer_reply: Hi Jayesh, thanks for the detailed report — both bugs are fixed! Startup is now instant (we no longer wait on the network), and groups can now be opened to add/remove habits inside. Rolling out now as update 1.1.1. Thanks for helping us improve!

text: Additive design 🤩🤩
author: Lisha Sajith
developer_reply: Thank you Lisha! The bold neo-brutalist look is our signature — lots more coming. Enjoy building your streaks! 🔥

text: App is ok, Very Costly..
author: Anu Priya
developer_reply: Thanks for the feedback! LifeEngine is free for up to 5 habits with streaks, reminders and stats included. Pro is a one-time purchase (no subscription) and we run regular launch discounts — keep an eye out. We hear you on pricing and keep reviewing it.

text: not working the status bar is blinking and app exiting

developer_reply: So sorry about that — we're actively investigating the status-bar flicker and crash on newer Android versions. A major stability update (1.1.1) is rolling out now; please update and if it still happens, contact us via the store support email so we can fix your exact case fast.
